1º de Primaria · Inglés

Food

Ficha para imprimir
123456
1

Pregunta de arranquePiensa 30 segundos antes de seguir

What do you have for breakfast? Can you say it in English?

Escribe o di en voz alta tu respuesta. Después .

Maybe milk, bread or an apple. In this unit you will learn food words and say what you like.

2

Aprende12 apartados

Para empezar: The picnic

It is a sunny Saturday. Nora and her dad go to the park for a picnic.

Dad opens the basket. «What's in it?» asks Nora.

«Bread, cheese, apples, bananas and water», says Dad.

«I like bananas!» says Nora. «I don't like cheese.»

«Do you like apples?» asks Dad. «Yes, I do! They are red and sweet.»

A little bird looks at the bread. Nora gives it a small piece. «You're hungry too!» she laughs.

1. I'm hungry!

When we want to eat, we say I'm hungry!

When we want to drink, we say I'm thirsty!

Then we eat food and drink water. Are you hungry now?

Vídeo: Are You Hungry? Kids Healthy Food Song · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 182,4 millones de visualizaciones

2. Fruit

Fruit is sweet and healthy.

This is an apple. This is a banana. This is a pear.

And these are grapes. Which fruit is your favourite?

3. Breakfast food

In the morning we have breakfast.

We can eat bread or cereal. We can drink milk or orange juice.

Breakfast gives us energy for the day. What's your breakfast today?

4. More food

Here is more food.

Cheese is made from milk. Chicken and fish are good for our muscles.

Soup is hot. Water is the best drink. Let's drink water every day!

5. I like…

To say what we enjoy, we say I like…

I like apples. I like bread. I like milk.

Smile and rub your tummy when you say it. Yummy!

6. I don't like…

To say we don't enjoy something, we say I don't like…

I don't like cheese. I don't like soup.

It's OK! Everybody likes different food. But it's good to try new things.

Vídeo: Do You Like Broccoli Ice Cream? Food Song for Kids · Super Simple Songs (YouTube) · 1122,4 millones de visualizaciones

7. Do you like…?

To ask a friend, we say Do you like…?

Do you like bananas? Answer: Yes, I do! or No, I don't.

Ask five friends about their favourite food. Listen to the answers.

8. Healthy food

Some food is very healthy: fruit, vegetables, fish and water.

Some food is a treat: sweets, chocolate and cakes. We eat treats only sometimes.

Eat colours! Red tomatoes, green peas, orange carrots. A colourful plate is a healthy plate.

Vídeo: Fruits and Vegetables: Yummy Fruits and Veggies · English Singsing (YouTube) · 50,2 millones de visualizaciones

9. Meals

We have meals during the day.

In the morning: breakfast. At midday: lunch. In the evening: dinner.

At meals we say Can I have some water, please? and Thank you!

10. Let's make a fruit salad

Let's make a fruit salad!

First, wash the fruit. Then, with an adult, cut an apple, a banana and an orange.

Put it all in a bowl. Add some grapes. Mix it. Now eat it. Mmm, delicious!

11. Game: the shop

Play the food shop with a friend.

Shopper: Can I have two apples, please? Shopkeeper: Here you are!

Shopper: Thank you! Goodbye! Now change roles and buy other food.

12. Review: yummy food

Now you know many food words: apple, banana, pear, grapes, bread, milk, cheese, eggs and water.

You can say I like… and I don't like…

You can ask Do you like…? And you know healthy food. Excellent!

Lo hacemos juntos · Let's do it together

Say that you like bananas.

  1. Start with: I like…
  2. Add the food in plural: bananas.

Resultado: I like bananas.

Ask a friend about milk.

  1. Start with: Do you like…
  2. Add: milk?

Resultado: Do you like milk?

You don't like soup. Answer: Do you like soup?

  1. The answer is no.
  2. Short answer: No, I don't.

Resultado: No, I don't.

What meal do you have in the evening?

  1. Morning: breakfast. Midday: lunch.
  2. Evening is the last meal.

Resultado: Dinner.

Errores típicos

  • Saying «I no like»: we say «I don't like».
  • Answering «Yes, I like» to «Do you like…?»: the short answer is «Yes, I do».
  • Saying «a apple»: we say «an apple».
  • Saying «I like banana»: we usually say «I like bananas» (plural).

PracticaResponde sin mirar arriba. Equivocarse aquí también enseña.

Ejercicios (22)

Hazlos en tu cuaderno y después abre la solución.

Nivel básico

  1. Say three fruits in English.

    Ver solución
    Apple, banana, pear (or grapes).

  2. Draw an apple and colour it red.

    Ver solución
    A red apple.

  3. Rub your tummy and say: I'm hungry!

    Ver solución
    I'm hungry!

  4. What colour is a banana?

    Ver solución
    Yellow.

  5. Match: pan – bread, leche – milk.

    Ver solución
    Bread = pan; milk = leche.

  6. Point to the cheese in the picture.

    Ver solución
    The cheese.

  7. What do you drink when you are thirsty?

    Ver solución
    Water.

  8. Say: Yummy!

    Ver solución
    Yummy!

Nivel medio

  1. Complete: I ____ apples. (😊)

    Ver solución
    like.

  2. Complete: I ____ cheese. (😞)

    Ver solución
    don't like.

  3. Answer: Do you like milk?

    Ver solución
    Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

  4. Ask a friend: Do you like…?

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: Do you like grapes?

  5. Draw your breakfast and write two words.

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: milk, bread.

  6. Write two healthy foods.

    Ver solución
    For example, fruit and fish.

  7. Order the meals: dinner, breakfast, lunch.

    Ver solución
    Breakfast, lunch, dinner.

  8. Complete: Can I have some ____, please?

    Ver solución
    water / bread / milk (free answer).

  9. It's ___ apple.

    Ver solución
    an.

Nivel avanzado

  1. Make a food survey: ask five friends Do you like…? and draw a chart.

    Ver solución
    Free answer: a simple bar chart.

  2. Write a menu for a healthy lunch.

    Ver solución
    For example: soup, fish, salad, an apple and water.

  3. Describe your favourite food: My favourite food is… It's…

    Ver solución
    Free answer, for example: My favourite food is pizza. It's yummy!

  4. Play the shop: buy three things politely.

    Ver solución
    Can I have…, please? Here you are! Thank you!

  5. Make a fruit salad at home with an adult and say the fruits in English.

    Ver solución
    Free answer.
4

Explícalo con tus palabrasComo si se lo contaras a alguien de un curso menor

¿Has nombrado estas ideas?
★

Situación de aprendizajeOur healthy menu

We design a healthy menu for a day and present it in English with drawings.

Pasos

  1. In groups, we choose food for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
  2. We draw the food on a big paper plate for each meal.
  3. We write the names in English and mark healthy food with a tick.
  4. We present it: «For breakfast, we have milk and an apple. We like apples!».

Producto final: A healthy menu with three paper plates and labels in English.

Cómo se valora

  • Names food in English.
  • Uses I like / I don't like and Do you like…?
  • Chooses healthy food for each meal.

Resumen visualTodo el tema en una pantalla

Glosario

Food
Things we eat (comida).
Fruit
Sweet food from plants, like apples (fruta).
Apple
A round fruit, red or green (manzana).
Banana
A long yellow fruit (plátano).
Bread
Food made with flour (pan).
Milk
A white drink from cows (leche).
Water
The best drink (agua).
Hungry
When you want to eat (con hambre).
Healthy
Good for your body (sano).
Breakfast
The first meal of the day (desayuno).
6

Tarjetas de repasoToca la tarjeta para darle la vuelta

Según cómo respondas, la tarjeta vuelve mañana, en 3, en 7 o en 21 días.

Para familias

  • Al hacer la compra, nombrad en inglés la fruta que metéis en el carro.
  • En la mesa, practicad: «Can I have some water, please?».
  • Preparad juntos una macedonia y nombrad cada fruta.
  • Preguntad «Do you like…?» y que conteste «Yes, I do / No, I don't».

Para profesores

Saberes: Lengua extranjera (Inglés): léxico de alimentos y comidas del día; estructuras I like / I don't like, Do you like…? Yes, I do / No, I don't; Can I have…, please?; hábitos de alimentación saludable (RD 157/2022, primer ciclo de Educación Primaria).

  • Encuesta de gustos con gráfico de barras en la pizarra.
  • Tienda de alimentos con diálogos de compra.
  • Macedonia en clase (respetando alergias) nombrando las frutas.
  • Clasificación de alimentos en «every day» y «sometimes».

Fuentes y revisión

  • Real Decreto 157/2022, enseñanzas mínimas de la Educación Primaria (BOE)

Revisado el 14 de noviembre de 2026.

Qué vas a aprender

  • Name fruit: apple, banana, orange, pear, grapes
  • Name other food: bread, cheese, milk, water, eggs
  • Say I like… and I don't like…
  • Ask and answer Do you like…? Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
  • Talk about healthy food and meals

Palabras clave

food · apple · banana · bread · milk · water · I like · I don't like · Do you like…? · hungry · healthy

Tiempo

50 minutos hoy + 2 minutos en cada repaso
